built_in_protocol: reference-guided generation on sampled-magenta chroma, then deterministic alpha extraction
canvas_intent: portrait, consistent three-quarter-body VN framing, face and gesture above bottom 25 percent dialogue-safe zone

mirelle_voss.reference_roles: Image 1 is the canonical active-profile authority for outfit, palette, weapon, rendering style, and overall identity. Image 2 is the facial-identity authority for face shape, amber-brown eyes, copper-red hairline, and high braided ponytail. Image 3 is body-proportion authority only; do not copy its training clothes. Image 4 is rear-costume and braid authority only. Reconcile them into the same woman; do not place the references in the output.
mirelle_voss.subject: Mirelle is a tall athletic human woman in her late twenties with a sun-warm complexion, sharp expressive face, amber-brown eyes, and copper-red hair in one high thick braided ponytail. Preserve her fitted cream/ivory fighting half-coat, oxblood underlayers, leather harness and guards, bright steel shoulder armor, repaired crimson cuff stitching, tall oxblood boots, and restrained arena-captain design. She owns exactly one long ash-shaft spear with exactly one leaf-shaped steel spearhead and one restrained red-silk tassel immediately beneath that head; no second spear, no double-ended spear, no duplicate blade.
mirelle_voss.orientation: Her body remains angled three-quarters toward screen-left so this pack can occupy the right VN slot.
mirelle_voss.edge_details: complete high braid, coat tails, fingers, continuous spear shaft, tassel strands, and spearhead
mirelle_voss.constraints: Exactly one Mirelle; exactly two natural hands with five fingers each where visible; exactly one spear owned and held only by her; coherent unbroken limbs and weapon shaft; canonical outfit remains fully clothed and unchanged.
mirelle_voss.avoid: Extra people, duplicates, extra arms, extra fingers, fused hands, extra weapons, detached weapon parts, double-ended spear, shield, sword, exposed underwear, sexualized posing, windblown costume redesign, environment, glow effects, particles, cropped head, cropped hands, or cropped spearhead.

variants.neutral: Neutral attentive confidence: relaxed brows, steady eyes, closed resting mouth with no overt smile. Stand tall with weight relaxed over the rear leg, shoulders open, outer hand holding the single spear planted upright beside her outer side, inner hand resting loosely at her hip. The stance reads composed even without the face.
variants.happy: Open genuine happiness: bright eyes, lifted cheeks, and a broad warm grin without caricature. Lean forward slightly with open shoulders, weight moving toward the viewer-side leg; keep the single spear planted upright in the outer hand while the inner arm extends in a welcoming open-palm gesture. The stance reads delighted even without the face.
variants.concerned: Quiet concern: brows drawn together, eyes softened and focused toward screen-left, lips slightly parted. Incline head and shoulders toward the unseen speaker, keep the single spear upright and close in the outer hand, and raise the inner hand lightly toward her sternum as if about to offer help. The stance reads protective concern even without the face.
variants.tense: Controlled tension: widened alert eyes, brows low but not angry, lips pressed, jaw set. Lower her center of gravity into an evenly balanced guarded stance, shoulders tight, both hands gripping the single spear diagonally across the lower torso as a defensive barrier rather than an attack. The stance reads wary and braced even without the face.
variants.skeptical: Dry skepticism: one eyebrow distinctly raised, eyes narrowed toward screen-left, mouth pulled into a small doubtful corner. Settle her weight onto one hip, keep the single spear planted upright in the outer hand, and fold the inner forearm loosely across her waist beneath the spear hand. The asymmetrical posture reads unimpressed even without the face.
variants.angry: Fierce controlled anger: lowered brows, narrowed eyes, clenched jaw with slightly bared teeth, no smile. Form a forward braced stance with weight committed into the front leg. Both hands grip the single spear well apart, holding it diagonally across her body in a clear ready guard. Keep the spear and both hands separated and readable rather than crossing the face.
variants.sad: Unmasked sadness: lowered wet-looking eyes, inner brows raised, lips pressed gently with no smile. Bow the head, let the shoulders and chest sink, bring the feet closer together, plant the single spear vertically beside her, and rest both hands one over the other on its shaft for support. The stance reads grief and diminished confidence even without the face.
variants.surprised: Sudden surprise: eyes wide, eyebrows high, mouth open in a small sharp intake of breath. Recoil through the shoulders with weight shifted onto the rear leg; keep control of the single spear in the outer hand as it tilts away from her, while the inner hand rises open with spread fingers. The stance reads startled even without the face.

rowan_kest.reference_roles: Image 1 is the canonical active-profile authority for outfit, palette, paired knives, rendering style, and overall identity. Image 2 is the facial-identity authority for face shape, green eyes, warm olive complexion, tousled ash-blond hair, and small left-ear hoop. Image 3 is body-proportion authority only; do not copy its training clothes. Image 4 is rear-costume, scarf, map-case, and paired-sheath authority only. Reconcile them into the same man; do not place the references in the output.
rowan_kest.subject: Rowan is a lean athletic human man in his late twenties with a warm olive complexion, keen green eyes, tousled ash-blond hair, a straight narrow nose, and a small hoop in his left ear. Preserve his cropped charcoal leather scout jacket over fitted brown wool, long forest-green scarf, slim iron bracers, weathered high brown boots, and low cross-body map case. He owns exactly two mismatched short knives: one broad utility blade and one narrow fighting blade. Any sheathed knife must show a distinct hilt at the paired sheath on his outer hip; never add a third weapon.
rowan_kest.orientation: His body remains angled three-quarters toward screen-right so this pack can occupy the left VN slot.
rowan_kest.edge_details: hair tips, fingers, scarf edges, knife blades or hilts, map case, straps, and boots
rowan_kest.constraints: Exactly one Rowan; exactly two natural hands with five fingers each where visible; exactly two mismatched short knives owned only by him in the stated drawn-or-sheathed arrangement; coherent unbroken limbs; canonical outfit remains fully clothed and unchanged.
rowan_kest.avoid: Extra people, duplicates, extra arms, extra fingers, fused hands, extra knife, missing knife, sword, shield, duplicate map case, exposed underwear, sexualized posing, costume redesign, environment, glow effects, particles, cropped head, cropped hands, or cropped knife details.

variants.neutral: Neutral watchfulness: relaxed brows, steady green eyes, closed resting mouth with only the faintest trace of his usual crooked smile. Stand easily with weight on one leg, shoulders loose, inner hand resting near the map-case strap and outer hand hanging clear of exactly two fully sheathed knives. The stance reads alert but uncommitted even without the face.
variants.happy: Unrestrained happiness: bright eyes, lifted cheeks, and a quick broad grin. Lean forward lightly with open shoulders as if sharing a joke, extend the inner hand in a loose animated gesture, and let the outer hand rest at his hip away from exactly two fully sheathed knives. The stance reads buoyant even without the face.
variants.concerned: Sincere concern: brows pinched, eyes softened toward screen-right, lips slightly parted with his smile completely gone. Incline head and shoulders toward the unseen speaker, extend the inner hand halfway in an offer of help, and keep the outer hand open near exactly two fully sheathed knives without touching them. The stance reads attentive worry even without the face.
variants.tense: Cold precise tension: narrowed alert eyes, level lowered brows, lips pressed, usual grin absent. Drop into a compact balanced scout stance; draw only the broad utility knife into the outer hand in a low reverse grip while the narrow fighting knife remains visibly sheathed at his outer hip. Keep both weapon identities distinct and separated. The stance reads ready to move, not attacking.
variants.skeptical: Measured skepticism: one eyebrow raised, eyes narrowed in thought toward screen-right, head tilted a few degrees, mouth held in a small doubtful half-line rather than a grin. Settle weight casually on one leg, hold the inner hand palm-up in a restrained questioning gesture, and let the outer hand rest loosely near but not on exactly two fully sheathed knives. The asymmetrical shoulders read skeptical even without the face.
variants.angry: Sharp active anger: eyes narrowed, brows driven down, teeth barely bared, all charm gone. Brace forward with bent knees and separated arms; hold the broad utility knife low in the outer hand and the narrow fighting knife higher in the inner hand, both clearly drawn and visibly different, with no sheathed duplicate hilts. The stance reads aggressive anger even without the face.
variants.sad: Quiet private sadness: eyes lowered, inner brows raised, lips pressed into a small exhausted line. Round the shoulders, bow the head, draw the scarf closer with the inner hand, and let the outer hand hang open well away from exactly two fully sheathed knives. The stance reads withdrawn grief even without the face.
variants.surprised: Sudden surprise: eyes wide, eyebrows high, mouth open slightly. Recoil with weight onto the rear leg, lift the inner hand open with fingers spread, and pull the outer elbow back protectively while keeping exactly two knives fully sheathed and visibly distinct at the outer hip. The stance reads caught off guard even without the face.
